vercel.json.note: included verbatim in the deployment source; applied as project config, not served

verification.headlessChromeRender: app.js executes under the strict meta CSP (script-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net + SRI): the rendered DOM grows from 91190 B to ~98.6 KB and contains the intro gate (.intro, .intro-brand, .intro-body, .intro-cta) with the «Запустить ритуал» CTA; no CSP or SRI violations in the console.
verification.ssoCheck: All three URLs of the project (public alias, -singularity16 alias, raw deployment URL) return HTTP 200 with the full 91190-byte v20 page and no vercel.com/sso-api redirect, so Vercel Authentication remains off at the project level. No protection settings were changed.
verification.previousLiveVersion: v21 monolith (index.html 288261 B, sha256 8169dfc4…, no app.js) — replaced.
verification.docsDirectoryNotDeployed: docs/ (GitHub Pages copy of v21 on main) was intentionally excluded from the deployment; /docs -> 404.

method.tool: Vercel MCP deploy_to_vercel (target=production, name=proklinator-static, teamId omitted)
method.description: build.mjs fetches the 13 site files from raw.githubusercontent.com (fallback: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh) at the pinned commit f87ee40 and aborts unless each file's byte length and SHA-256 match the values in `files` above, then writes them to ./public. The deployment therefore contains exactly the repo bytes of the pinned commit.

notes: PR #3 was already merged into main (f87ee40) at deploy time, so main was used as the source rather than the branch singularity/v20-production-complete-5942 (same tree: 5ef7313 is the branch head and the second parent of f87ee40).

teamId was omitted from deploy_to_vercel, as in the prior successful deploy; the deployment landed in the singularity16 scope. Team-scoped read endpoints (get_project, list_projects, get_deployment) return 404 / empty for this token, so verification was done over HTTP against the public alias, the -singularity16 alias and the raw deployment URL.
The existing project proklinator-static was reused (protection already off); no new project was created and no auth/protection settings were touched.
Site files were not inlined in the MCP request (payload was 4.6 KB of build scaffolding); the ~644 KB of site bytes were fetched and SHA-256-verified during the Vercel build.
